verification.notes: Unverifiable. While it is confirmed that Egyptian Air Force aircraft SU-BTT (Dassault Falcon 7X) arrived at Provo on September 4, 2025 for scheduled maintenance at Duncan Aviation and departed on September 10, 2025, the specific claim about it only visiting the U.S. twice in the past year, both times in weeks leading up to Kirk's assassination, cannot be verified from available sources. Flight tracking data for SU-BTT exists but comprehensive historical records for all U.S. visits are not publicly available to confirm or refute this specific claim.

records.text: An anonymous CBS town hall attendee reported that Erika Kirk said she was pregnant when the Egyptian planes were following her, was not on them, and had photographic proof
records.speaker: CBS town hall attendee email source (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: And this is what she said about the conspiracies and Candace. One, Erika (Erika Kirk) said she was pregnant when the Egyptian planes were flying and following her. ... So she wasn't on them. She said she has photo proof. Huh?

verification.notes: The anonymous attendee report was checked against the subsequently released full town hall. Kirk said she was pregnant for most of the cited trips, denied being on the Egyptian planes, and said she had a phone photo showing she was in a hospital with contractions on a disputed date. This verifies the report of what Kirk said, not the underlying aircraft-tracking allegation.

records.text: Candace Owens said she felt very confident that Egyptian planes regularly flew in and out of Israel and turned off their transponders each time.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I also want to say to you that I feel very confident that I know why these planes have caused such panic. And it is because there is overwhelming evidence that these planes regularly fly in and out of Israel. And I'm going to present that evidence tomorrow. I say that strongly. This is the Like I feel very confident saying these Egyptian planes are flying in and out and notice I'm saying planes because once I was able to connect people that were on those planes onto other Egyptian planes, I was able to realize that these planes are flying in and out of Israel and turning their transponder off each time that they do it.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 2058.708 states Owens's confidence and promised later evidence. Current secondary analyses dispute parts of her flight-location dataset, but no accessible raw or archived ADS-B record was found that cross-checks every relevant aircraft by both tail number and Mode-S/ICAO hex across the claimed Israel legs. Under the historical-aircraft evidence rule, tracker gaps and conflicting reconstructions cannot prove or disprove the claim.
